description: Agent quiz for agent.py: one agent with note search + number tools. Everything is FICTIONAL (sample_notes/ + sample_data/cafe_numbers.json, Ember & Oak Coffee). Each item lists the tools it MUST call (expected_tools), note facts the answer must contain (expected_facts, same format as golden.json), optional forbidden_facts (near-miss wrong answers a substring check would pass), and whether the answer must quote a number a tool actually returned in that run (grounded_number).

items.question: What is my emergency fund target?
What time does the café open on Sundays?
What process does Verde use for our decaf?
What were the café's total sales in August 2026?
How much did we spend on green beans in July 2026?
How much cash does the café have across all its accounts right now?
How much is in the emergency fund now, and what is my target?
What was the café's profit in August 2026, and how much do I set aside each month?
How much did we spend on green beans in August 2026, and what is our biggest standing order with Highland?
